Scott Hamilton plays the tenor saxophone in a manner that harkens back to the era of Coleman Hawkins and Ben Webster. Born in Providence, RI in 1954, his move to New York at the age of 22 proved fruitful. After establishing himself as a player of authority, he found work with Benny Goodman, Rosemary Clooney and formed a working partnership with Warren Vache. In the 80s, Scott worked with such touring bands as the Concord Jazz All Stars and the Newport Festival All Stars. He is a gifted improviser who has extended the classic tenor tax tradition into the 90s.
